grains.RAW.SITES: one row per mining or processing site
grains.RAW.SITE_DAILY: one row per site per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.REHAB_PROGRESS: one row per site (land rehabilitation snapshot)

metrics.Discharge Within Threshold: 100 * SUM(SAMPLES_IN_LIMIT) / SUM(WATER_SAMPLES) (internal demo threshold, not a regulatory limit)
metrics.Emissions Intensity: 1000 * SUM(CO2E_TONNES) / SUM(ORE_TONNES) (kg CO2e per tonne handled)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.exceedance_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(environmental exceedance in next 7 days) per site, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day operator-wide CO2e emissions FORECAST; discharge-turbidity ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ESG_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic exceedance-response SOPs (one per site type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.ESG_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.ESG_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, exceedance, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (sites with observations, daily discharge within threshold, exceedances by site, exceedance risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
